findings.evidenceJa: いつも穏やかに微笑んでいた
findings.governingReading: He recalls her continual peaceful smiling.
findings.explanation: The finite was is missing from Sakura’s remembered smile.

findings.highlight: If I can just get rid of him, then all this will...!
findings.evidenceJa: あいつさえいなければ、こんな事には
findings.governingReading: His earlier normal-life counterfactual ends if Zouken had not been there; he then challenges what would really have been different without him.
findings.explanation: The fantasy of events having been different without Zouken becomes a future remedy, followed by asking what Shirou can do.

findings.highlight: I was the only person who failed to notice any of it.
findings.evidenceJa: 気付かなかったのは俺だけの落ち度だ
findings.governingReading: 俺だけの落ち度 isolates his blame for not noticing, irrespective of Zouken’s crimes.
findings.explanation: Sole responsibility for his own failure becomes being the sole person who failed to notice.

findings.evidenceJa: 人々を救うからと、こうして生きていられた
findings.governingReading: The commitment to save people from arbitrary calamity has enabled or justified his continuing to live.
findings.explanation: Saving others remains his purpose, but the English shifts from what has allowed him to keep living to how he has chosen to live. This softens the personal dependence expressed at this decision.

findings.highlight: I saw you walking around town
findings.evidenceJa: 町を歩いてたらシロウがいたから
findings.governingReading: 町を歩いてたら is Illya’s account of her walk; せっかく会えた expresses the precious chance to meet.
findings.explanation: Illya walking around and happening upon Shirou becomes seeing him walking and having come all the way to meet him.

findings.highlight: Illya's just trying to make me feel better, but I'm pushing her away.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が楽になりたくてイリヤを追い払っている
findings.governingReading: 自分が楽になりたくて describes the selfish motive he condemns in himself.
findings.explanation: Shirou driving Illya away for his own relief becomes Illya trying to make him feel better.

findings.evidenceJa: リンはライダーにやられかけた
findings.governingReading: やられかけた marks the near outcome in Illya’s combat report.
findings.explanation: Rin nearly being defeated becomes having lost to Rider.
